audit.intended_rules: Chapter 6 Tier 2 nightly room cap (Berlin €160) with VAT on the excess; Chapter 6 parking rule requiring the note to identify a rental/pool vehicle (EV-charging parking deducted in full when absent); Chapter 6 minibar always deducted; Chapter 9 trade-fair surcharge override as a distractor ("AI Summit Berlin" is not a listed event); city tax reimbursed in full.
consistency_issues: Minor schema quirk: the Executive Lounge Day Pass incidental is tagged category "laundry" even though it is a workspace/meeting booth; the description governs, and the validator accepts it, but the tag is misleading.
audit.notes: Validator passes: line items multiply out, subtotal 464 + city tax 15 + VAT 32.48 = 511.48, charges list mirrors items. No label.json or receipt.jpg in the case directory. Adjudication: stay is Mon-Tue nights, so Figure 1 is irrelevant; "AI Summit Berlin" is not a Chapter 9 listed event, so the Berlin Tier 2 cap of €160/night applies — deduct (175-160)x2 = 30 + 2.10 VAT. Minibar line 16 + 1.12 VAT deducted (the "Truffle Cashews" wording is a harmless distractor; minibar is deducted regardless of Figure 3). Parking at exactly the €30/night cap is deducted in full (60 + 4.20 VAT) because the note never identifies a rental or pool vehicle. Lounge day pass (business video call stated in note) and city tax are reimbursable. Correct outcome: partially approved, reimbursed EUR 398.06 of 511.48. Difficulty: subtle_multi — requires combining the tier cap + VAT-on-excess treatment, the parking note condition, and the minibar deduction, with the event-surcharge override as a near-miss distractor. Realistic Berlin folio (plausible address, DE tax ID, market-rate room, sensible incidental prices). Fits the subtle_multi distribution; keep as is.
